headline: Claude Code 2.1.312 and Codex 0.165.0 shipped, and both now change defaults, so check the model-switch and memory settings.

themes.title: Defaults and rewind behave differently now
themes.facts: Codex turns memory v2 on for new profiles ([rust-v0.165.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.165.0)) and Claude Code widens automatic model switches to custom model names ([2.1.312](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.312)). Claude Code's `/rewind` no longer undoes `sed -i` edits, and `claude ultrareview` needs workspace trust in scripts ([2.1.309](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.309)).
themes.so_what: new defaults and scripts that ran unattended before may now change results or stop, so check those settings before you rely on them.

themes.title: Sandboxes and MCP servers are locked down
themes.facts: Claude Code stopped sandboxed commands from changing the `--mcp-config` file ([2.1.309](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.309)); agy blocks `~/.docker`, `~/.kube` and `~/_netrc` in its sandbox unless you grant access ([1.4.6](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.6)); Kilo Code's MCP SDK update fixes security issues but stops remote servers that redirect from connecting ([v7.8.18](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.18)).
themes.so_what: any sandbox or MCP setup that worked by accident may now need an explicit grant or a new URL.

themes.title: Plugins get new MCP and sign-in rules
themes.facts: `/plugin` now sets a plugin's MCP server variables without disabling it ([1.4.6](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.6)); plugin MCP tokens now belong to the signed-in user, so OAuth servers may ask you to sign in again ([1.4.7](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.4.7)).
themes.so_what: expect a one-time sign-in to plugin MCP servers after the agy 1.4.7 update.

watch_next: Antigravity CLI has no new release since 1.4.8. Check your Claude Code and Codex settings for the new defaults, and the 2.1.309 changes to `ultrareview` and `/rewind` may still break scripts.
